3686.title: Bhimtal
3686.extract:
Bhimtal is a small town in the Kumaon hills of Uttarakhand, India. Its main attraction is Bhimtal Lake, surrounded by wooded hills. The town is also a useful base for visiting Sattal, Naukuchiatal and other places in the Kumaon region.


Understand
Bhimtal is quieter than Nainital and is spread around the lake. Most visitors come for the lake, the surrounding countryside and the nearby temples and lakes.
The town has accommodation and restaurants around the lake and along the main roads.


Get in


By bus
Buses and shared vehicles connect Bhimtal with Haldwani, Kathgodam, Bhowali and Nainital.


By taxi
Taxis are readily available in Haldwani, Kathgodam and Nainital. A taxi is also convenient for visiting the nearby lakes.


By train
Kathgodam is the nearest railway station. From there, take a taxi or bus to Bhimtal.


By plane
Pantnagar Airport is the nearest airport with scheduled flights. Continue by road.


Get around

The lake area can be explored on foot. Auto-rickshaws, shared vehicles and taxis are useful for longer distances.
For Sattal and Naukuchiatal, a taxi is the easiest option.


See
1 Bhimtal Lake. The main attraction of Bhimtal. The lake is surrounded by wooded hills and has boating facilities. (updated Aug 2026)
2 Bhimeshwar Mahadev Temple. A Shiva temple on the eastern side of Bhimtal Lake. The present temple is associated with the 17th century. Local traditions connect the shrine with Bhima and the Pandavas. (updated Aug 2026)
3 Bhimtal Lake Dam. The dam at the southern end of Bhimtal Lake. (updated Aug 2026)


Do


Boating
Boating on Bhimtal Lake is one of the main activities in town. Availability, operating hours and prices may vary with weather and local conditions.


Walk around the lake
The lake and surrounding roads make for an easy walk, with views of the water and hills.


Photography
The lake is popular for photography, particularly in the morning and late afternoon.


Buy
There are small shops around the lake and in the town centre selling snacks, everyday goods and souvenirs.


Eat
Restaurants and cafés are concentrated around the lake and along the main road.
Local Kumaoni dishes are worth trying when available.


Sleep
Bhimtal has hotels, guesthouses, homestays and resorts. There are options around the lake as well as in the surrounding hills.


Stay safe
Hill roads can be narrow and winding. During the monsoon, rain can cause slippery roads and occasional landslides.
Take care near the lake and follow local instructions when boating.
Follow local instructions when boating. Take care near the water and on roads around the lake, particularly during rainy weather.
